$comment: Showcase registry: where each project's facts live and how the GitHub profile presents them. Facts (status, metrics, stack, summary) come from each project's showcase.json (or showcase/local/ for private projects and repos without one). Presentation (card accent, copy lines, README badges/prose) lives here. Run node scripts/showcase/sync-showcase.mjs after changing either.

tjn-claude.$comment: Counts are owned by ~/.claude/scripts/generate-counts.mjs (scripts/sync-claude-counts.sh in both repos); this file only supplies status for the README table.
